findings.desc: formal review host independence is enforced only by review:claude: and review:codex: string prefixes plus artifact digest existence. This can accept forged or duplicated local artifacts as independent host verdicts. Minimal fix: validate distinct review artifacts whose JSON content declares host/source identity, pass verdict, baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, headHash, and materialHash matching the formal proof; add wrong-host/same-file tests.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in c032c70e: formal review refs now require digest-verified artifact files, distinct Claude/Codex artifacts, JSON host/source/verdict fields, and baselineId/suiteRunId/claimTarget/headHash/materialHash bindings. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke and two-host REVIEW PASS.

findings.desc: capability_claim_formal_evaluate trusts existing baseline-suite-report.json top-level formal fields without rebuilding or revalidating underlying Engineering final reports, evidence refs, artifact digests, and receipt bindings. A hand-authored current-hash suite report can unlock Layer 2 without real final-report evidence. Minimal fix: formal evaluator must rebuild or revalidate Engineering suite from actual final-report artifacts before authorizing, with forged-suite regression coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in c032c70e: capability_claim_formal_evaluate rebuilds the Engineering suite from final-report artifacts and compares stored suite fields/bindings to rebuilt evidence before unlock; forged PASS suite summary without final reports remains LOCKED. Verified by lattice-baseline smoke forged-suite test and two-host REVIEW PASS.
